calculation.description: When lagged cross-asset 3-day dispersion is above its trailing 60-day median, rank assets by the negative residual from the cross-sectional median; higher values indicate stronger expected five-day rebound. All inputs are lagged at decision time.

parameters.condition: lagged median absolute residual above lagged trailing median

validation.regime_notes: Positive across the tested full sample; condition is cross-asset dispersion rather than observation-only macro data. Uncertainty remains material because the cross-section has 15 instruments.
